profile.other_tag_policy: Any tag outside the exact allowlist refuses this first variant, including tile tags, ColorMap/ICC, private ImageJ metadata/LUT/overlay blocks50838/50839 and unknown pointer-bearing tags. This is explicit unsupported required scope, not a commercial exclusion.
profile.ifd_validation: Require unique ascending tag IDs per IFD, bounded valid TIFF field types/counts and in-file value extents; follow next pointers with a bounded visited set, rejecting loops/duplicates/truncation. Metadata may share only an exactly matching typed value interval; pixel intervals never overlap each other or metadata. Gaps/unreferenced padding do not become pixels. Optional descriptive text is first-IFD-only or byte-identical on later pages; varying per-page text refuses rather than losing labels. Later-page calibration tags are absent as a group or reproduce the first page's normalized values; partial/conflicting declarations refuse. Canonical writer emits identical calibration tags on every page.
profile.strip_policy: Read any positive effective rows-per-strip and exact count/byte lengths under caps. Writer fixes rows-per-strip=min(Y,64); there is no compressor, tile, alpha, inversion, scaling or orientation conversion.
profile.writer_layout: Write one linked IFD per XY page, first description only, explicit classic little-endian tags and no ImageJ images= hint. Directory/payload interleaving is permitted because readers follow IFDs. Do not promise byte-identical output or an ImageJ native FileSaver layout.

axis_contract.file_page_order: C fastest, thenZ, thenT; p=((t*Z)+z)*C+c, all indices zero-based.
axis_contract.native_mapping: Assign each decoded page to native index((t*C)+c)*Z+z; never reinterpret the page vector directly as Dataset's table.
axis_contract.dimensions: C/Z/T each positive native int; checked P=C*Z*T equals complete explicit IFD count; S=1. Y/X come from every IFD and must agree.
axis_contract.singleton_policy: All six axes remain explicit in Dataset/inspection; no rank inference or C/S merging.

description_grammar.encoding: Bounded ASCII with exactly one terminal NUL and no interior NUL; LF or CRLF input; key=value lines; blank lines permitted; duplicate keys/escapes/unknown keys refuse.
description_grammar.ImageJ: Required nonempty bounded ASCII version marker. Product output marker is ImageJ=1.54r for this compatibility profile; Software identifies imagejxx rather than claiming ImageJ authored it.
description_grammar.counts: Decimal unsigned positive integers only; no bool/float coercion, signs, hex or overflow. Omitted counts default1. If all three axis keys are absent, use legacy Z=IFDcount,C=T=1 and explicitly record that default; otherwise their product must match exactly.
description_grammar.images: Optional read-only hint; if present must equal full explicit IFD count. Never synthesize hidden pages and never stop IFD inspection from this hint. Canonical writer omits it.
description_grammar.hyperstack: Absent/false permitted for C=T=1; literaltrue required for C>1 orT>1. Writer emits literaltrue with all channels/slices/frames keys, including singleton counts.
description_grammar.order: No order= override admitted; default pinned ImageJ C-fast mapping only.
description_grammar.numeric_fields: Finite decimal floating grammar parsed in C locale; no NaN/Inf/hex/locale comma. spacing/finterval positive; origin values onlyzero.
description_grammar.source_basis: Pinned FileSaver715-765, TiffDecoder201-215/833-834, FileOpener470-480/605-645, Opener817-822/914-927 and ImagePlus1916-1923. Source facts are not TU08 runtime qualification.

calibration_contract.xy: Both resolutions absent -> spacingX=spacingY=1 with default observations. Otherwise both positive RATIONALs plus explicit ResolutionUnit1 required; spacing=denominator/numerator in description unit. Never apply TIFF default inches to description units.
calibration_contract.z: Description spacing positive finite, otherwise1 with default observation. yunit/zunit, if present, must normalize to the same spatial unit; no mixed-axis units.
calibration_contract.time: T>1 requires explicit positive finite finterval. For T1 only, absent finterval ->1 with default observation. tunit absent means sec. Present zero/negative intervals refuse rather than invent scientific timing.
calibration_contract.origins: Missing or numericzero xorigin/yorigin/zorigin only. Writer refuses any nonzero native origin, nonidentity direction or nonzero time_origin instead of dropping it.

rational_precision_policy.wire_type: Unsigned TIFF RATIONAL: numerator and denominator in[1,4294967295]. A stored reciprocal resolutionn/d decodes spacingd/n in binary64.
rational_precision_policy.admission: Every requested X/Y spacing must be positive finite and within the positive RATIONAL interval. A writer must produce an integer pair whose decoded spacing satisfies relative_error<=1e-6; do not restrict admission to dyadic grids or silently cast/round the input metadata.
rational_precision_policy.absolute_error_rule: abs(decoded-requested)<=1e-6*abs(requested), evaluated in binary64 with an8-ULP comparison allowance only at the threshold; report actual absolute and relative errors.
rational_precision_policy.pair_choice: Any positive uint32 pair meeting the numeric policy is conforming; exact numerator/denominator bytes are not promised. Prefer an exact small reduced rational when available. Independent fixtures cover0.5,1.25,2.5 and nonbinary positive spacings.
rational_precision_policy.estimate: Metadata-only estimate reports the actual selected wire pairs, decoded output calibration and per-axis error before any source plane read/temp creation/user callback. Write must use those frozen pairs; no recomputation with a different library conversion.
rational_precision_policy.libtiff_prerequisite: TIFFSetField RATIONAL ingestion may quantize through float storage. Implement an explicit bounded rational encoder/tag path, or prove the pinned libtiff path admits every requested spacing under this policy. Any failure is an implementation gap to repair, not permission to narrow the declared profile or claim bitwise spacing retention.
rational_precision_policy.roundtrip: Pixels/shape exact; XY calibration is bounded-loss at the declared1ppm relative tolerance and reported before export. Z spacing and frame interval use max_digits10 decimal and must recover identical finite binary64 values. Origins/direction/unit tokens normalize under this contract.

native_api_boundary.write: Capture immutable Dataset handle, UTF8 path bytes, request, metadata, calibration/pairs, limits and control before callbacks; source planes remain borrowed immutable. Validate a returned plane's dimensions/type/policy and every canonical integer sample before writing that plane. Inspect/read likewise freeze path/request/limits/control before callbacks; a callback cannot redirect a call by mutating supplied objects.

Preserve callback exception type.
native_api_boundary.python: Expose the same typed inspection/result/limits/requests; strict integer indices reject bool/float and overflow. Python callbacks are retained/captured under GIL and invoked with GIL, native work may release it; exceptions/cancel publish no partial output.
native_api_boundary.compatibility: Do not change legacy imread/imwrite ndarray ranks, singleton squeezing, kwargs or broad codecs implicitly. Freeze matching-profile array adapter expectations before rerouting those calls. The new scientific Dataset API is explicit and must use C++.

inspection_resources_and_execution.all_caps_joint: Positive caps apply together; all shape/product/count/add/multiply/offset conversions use checked size_t/uint64 arithmetic before allocation/seek/int cast. A nominal individual maximum does not promise the complete combination fits.
inspection_order: Validate request/limits and check precancellation before user callbacks or side effects.
Open one read-only random-access source; record identity/size/change tokens; cap size and read classic header.

Bound raw IFD/tag counts/value extents/strip tables and aggregate metadata before libtiff allocation or sample decode; scan all IFDs and validate one homogeneous series and description/axis/calibration mapping. This admission scan polls the cancellation token directly and emits no user callbacks.
Compute aggregate native output, metadata/descriptor, row/strip and codec bound; refuse before Image allocation/sample reads.
For read, hold the opened source through decode, recheck observable identity/size/change tokens before returning; a changed source fails without owner publication.
inspection_resources_and_execution.mutable_file_precondition: The input file must remain unchanged during one call. Inspect does not authenticate future contents. Observe handle/file identity,size and change tokens before/after; reject observable changes. No cryptographic snapshot guarantee against a noncooperative in-place writer is claimed by this first service.
inspection_resources_and_execution.memory_mapping: Disable mmap and strip chopping explicitly(e.g reviewed rmc mode); raw IFD tables define the admitted strip contract. Use per-handle libtiff error/warning callbacks and TIFFOpenOptions single/cumulated allocation limits; do not mutate global libtiff handlers.

estimate_symbols.M: charged metadata bytes including all out-of-line tag values/strings/strip tables plus owned UTF8 path/request/text copies; validate sizes before cloning

inspection_resources_and_execution.write_working_upper_bound: checked(8*A +2*W +4*M +512*P +64*E +128*K +L +65536); borrowed retained source storage excluded, conservative one-provider-plane8*A included.
inspection_resources_and_execution.inspection_working_upper_bound: checked(4*M +512*P +64*E +128*K +L +65536); no decoded output or volume copy.
inspection_resources_and_execution.estimate_notes: These are conservative owned service/codec workspace estimates, excluding borrowed source buffers, OS page cache, allocator bookkeeping, caller callback allocations and unrelated process/GPU allocations. Metadata descriptor access is permitted; provider plane/region reads are not part of estimate. Validate and charge all borrowed metadata/path lengths before cloning mutable input. No whole encoded input/output buffer or TCZ volume copy. Confirm real native allocations against this bound during implementation rather than relabelling uncounted storage.
inspection_resources_and_execution.callbacks: Estimate and metadata admission have no user callbacks or provider plane/region reads; descriptor metadata access only. Valid precancel throws before callbacks. Complete structural/resource admission before emitting any user callback, so admission/budget refusals have zero callbacks. A successful inspect emits only its coarse progress(0,1)/(1,1) pair after admission, not fabricated per-IFD execution events. Admitted read/write emit one coarse pair plus checkpoints at bounded row/plane boundaries and stage progress only with a declared fixed total. Nested inspection does not create a second progress pair. Callback exceptions/self-cancel abort. No user callback under Document/application locks. Freeze valid UTF8/no-NUL path bytes and check actual platform/temporary path length before opening output.
inspection_resources_and_execution.cancellation: Poll before/after bounded IFD metadata steps, every scanline or at most65536samples of raw transfer, between planes and immediately before output replacement. No claim of interruption inside a blocking OS call.
writer_atomicity: Complete metadata/type/shape/rational/resource preflight before callbacks/provider reads/temp creation.
Create one unique sibling temp exclusively; never open/truncate the destination for codec writing. Failure to create is terminal, not an arbitrary retry loop.

Write bounded scanlines/IFDs, checking all codec and OS return values; close/flush successfully, independently verify written tag/rational/description descriptors match the frozen plan, and prepare any return data before publication.
Run final cancellation/checkpoint/completion callback before commit; any exception leaves existing destination byte-identical and removes only the owned temp.

Commit once by same-filesystem atomic rename/replace under explicit FailIfExists or ReplaceExisting policy; a lost race fails without overwriting under FailIfExists. No fallible user callbacks after replacement.
Atomic replacement is not a claim of power-loss durability or whole-process resource certification. Export itself never mutates source data/history/display/annotations/dirty/saved revisions.
